collection.title: Lamborghini Gallardo 2003 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lamborghini Gallardo 2003 - 2013 requires a front 26" wiper blade for both driver and passenger side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
